items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: So, him and Mr. Clayton come around there... He said, I'm looking for a band... I said, yeah, I don't mind... He said, I'll give you 25... I said, no, I don't want to talk about nothing... He said, well, I'm giving you room and board... So, I said, uh-huh, man. I can't believe it... I said, I know w

ctx.x: Yeah. Well he was from Harps, he had this band over here, see. You understand? Yeah. And so, Pearson stayed, see, he stayed over here with Tommy, see. And then I went on over here with this man, because he had a Tommy, and he was from Houston, he had a trumpet player, he had a fine band from Houston. But they couldn't dig the flow show. Now that's where my little reading ability came in handy, see. Because they had a flow show that they booked from Dallas and Oklahoma City. After Tokyo, Cesar Ramona was nothing…
Would you there, Mr. Clayton, come for me to go?
Well, that must have been him.
